name: Recruit CRM
summary: Recruit CRM charges $95, $135 and $215 per user a month for Pro, Business and Enterprise, with a 30-day trial on the first two. Job multiposting, AI sourcing, LinkedIn messaging and calling use credits, and each user receives a monthly allowance that is pooled across the account.

facts.text: Recruit CRM's Talent Pool form lets candidates submit a profile even when no listed job fits. The page can be embedded on a company website, and each submission sends the recruiter a notification.
A vendor blog post describes setting up a sequence of emails once and letting the system send them on triggers, and it presents this as a way to keep contact with passive candidates.
The LinkedIn integration page describes multi-step LinkedIn outreach sequences and a Chrome extension for adding profiles while browsing.

Credits are pooled at the account level. Job multiposting costs 25 credits per unique job, AI sourcing and matching 3 credits per 100 profiles, and LinkedIn messaging and project sync 150 credits per user a month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 100 free credits per user a month, 1 hiring pipeline, 1 mailbox and 1 multi-channel sequence.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 200 free credits per user a month, 100 pipelines, 2 mailboxes and up to 1,000 sequences with 500 active enrolments.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 2,000 free credits per user a month. Booked through a demo, with no trial listed.

hiddenCosts: The page does not say whether the listed prices are monthly or annual rates. A toggle offers savings of up to 17% on annual billing without listing the annual prices.
Advanced analytics costs 300 credits per user a month, WhatsApp messaging 100 credits, and workflow automation a base of 500 credits a month. The page gives no dollar price per credit.
Calling and texting credit use varies by country.
